utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Uli — if you can swing by, we still could use a few hand tools, sturdy boxes, and any spare tarps folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key and see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Uli — just bring whatever you can, and I’ll make sure it gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — the repair drive is at the community shed on Maple Lane, just past the playground, and the easiest route is from Oak Street with the signs to guide you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I’ll pass that along and keep bringing folks over to help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep the location handy in case anyone needs it again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you let me know if you spot any neighbors who need repairs or supplies? I’m keeping the list updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear of anyone who needs repairs or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Sam — that’s a big help. I’ll keep the list updated, so just send me anything you hear.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll do that, Rosa — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and let you know what they need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the list updated, so just send me what you find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do, Rosa — I’ll start checking in today and send you anything I find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I still haven’t caught the new details either. Once you check the location, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll check the location details and send you the update as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — appreciate it. I’ll wait for your update and keep the repair drive moving once I have the new location.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’m ready for your notes, and I’ll get started as soon as you send the first couple of things to grab.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll sort my notes and send the first couple of things to grab soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll watch for your note and jump on the first couple of items as soon as you send them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got it covered — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdriver set, and spare screws today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that’s perfect and a huge help. Just bring those along, and I’ll get us set up when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll see you there today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll take a quick look by the hall and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Bo — I’ll keep the tape and screws ready in case they need them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll check the sign and let you know if tape or screws are on the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Let’s do the faucet first if that’s okay — it sounds like the most urgent. I’ll keep it short and send you just the basics.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — just send the basics and the timing when you can, and I’ll see if I can fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I’ll keep it brief and send the basics and timing soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem, Dane — I’ve got the tape and screws set aside. See you there, even if you’re a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll swing by late, but I’ll bring what I can and help out when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep the tape and screws ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Just the basics is perfect — I’ll help if I can, quietly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll keep it to the basics and quiet. I think we should start with the leaky faucet unless the front-step rail turns out to be more urgent.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The faucet sounds fine to start with — I can help quietly if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can mention it to anyone who needs it — Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and they can bring broken small appliances or tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’s a great quick summary. I’ll pass along the time and what to bring so folks can join in easily.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Jules — that’ll help a lot. If anyone asks, just tell them Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center and to bring broken small appliances or tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — send me the list when you have it, and I’ll have the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do — I’m checking the list now and I’ll send you exactly what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Hana — thanks for checking. I’ll keep my toolbox ready and set aside whatever you need once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik — 10 tomorrow works for me. Send the fixes over and we’ll go through them one by one.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — 10 tomorrow it is, and I’ll send the fixes so we can go through them one by one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll be ready at 10 tomorrow and we can work through the fixes one by one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — I’d only reach out to a small, transparent list: the usual tools-and-supplies folks plus a couple of trusted neighbors. If you want, I can name everyone before I contact them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’d be best — can you name them first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’d contact Sam, Priya, and Ben from the tools-and-supplies crew, plus Lena and Marco, who’ve helped out before. If that list looks good, I’ll hold off until you say go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me — I can be there at 10 and help sort donations and hand out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — that’s perfect. We start at 10 and go until noon, and I’d really appreciate your help sorting donations and handing out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll be there at 10 and help with donations and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still set for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll keep it simple: 10 tomorrow morning, and I’ll send over the fixes and hauling list before then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks — I’ll look for the fixes and hauling list before tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll send the fixes and hauling list before 10 tomorrow morning, and we’ll go through them one by one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll go check the sign by the hall and see what tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — let me know what it says, and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll take a look and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep inviting folks, and the more hands we get, the better the repair drive will go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and see who needs repairs or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Rey — the more neighbors we reach, the better. I’ll keep spreading the word and line up more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — 10 to noon works for me, and I’ll be there to help sort donations and hand out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks, Faye — I’ll bring the schedule by after errands so you can line it up with school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll plan around drop-off and pickup, and I’ll be ready at 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m on my way and can catch the quick summary when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — I’ll keep it brief and have the fixes lined up when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, see you soon — I’ll jump in and help with the fixes once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You bet — I’ll start by talking to a few neighbors and see who has donations or tools to spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Sam — thank you. If you hear of any hand tools, sturdy boxes, or spare tarps, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for hand tools, sturdy boxes, and spare tarps, and I’ll pass anything along to you right away.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
